Google AdMob & GDPR Compliant

Privacy Policy for TipPulse Reader

Effective Date: August 21, 2026

1. Overview

TipPulse ("we", "our", or "the App") respects your privacy. This policy outlines how data is handled across our content and reading features.

2. Offline-First Data Storage

TipPulse operates using local storage on your device. Your saved bookmarks, reading history, preferred font sizes, and theme settings stay strictly on your device.

3. Advertising via Google AdMob

This application integrates Google AdMob (Google LLC) to deliver mobile advertising. Google AdMob may collect and process device identifiers, IP addresses, and diagnostic information to display personalized or non-personalized advertisements.

  • GDPR / EEA & UK Compliance: Users in the European Economic Area and United Kingdom can manage consent preferences through the in-app Ad Preferences settings or Google UMP modal.
  • CCPA / California Privacy: California residents can opt-out of interest-based data processing via system ad settings.

4. Children's Online Privacy (COPPA)

TipPulse does not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. All ads served comply with Google Play family and general audience safety policies.

5. Contact & Support

For questions or requests regarding this Privacy Policy, contact us at: privacy@tippulse.app
